title: Immunostaining Protocol for Mitochondrial Morphology in iPSC-Derived Neurons
author: Alfred Kibowen
materials: Prepare primary antibodies in blocking solution with the following combinations and ratios: for mitochondrial morphology: MAP2 (1:1000) + TOMM20 (1:200) for OXPHOS complex expression: MAP2 (1:1000) + OXPHOS antibody cocktail (1:500)
Prepare secondary antibodies in blocking solution at 1:500 dilution. The combination of secondary antibodies is determined by the species of the primary antibodies used in the experiment.

steps.title: Seed neurons in 96-well plate
steps.instruction: Seed 1.5 × 10^4 Day 5 iPSC-derived glutamatergic neurons (iGLUTs) per well of a 96-well imaging plate and continue differentiation until Day 21 before antibody staining.

steps.title: Fix cells with paraformaldehyde
steps.instruction: Fix cells with a solution containing 4 % paraformaldehyde and 4 % sucrose in DPBS for 10 minutes at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Wash and block cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with DPBS, then incubate them in blocking solution containing 2 % normal donkey serum and 0.1 % Triton in DPBS for 2 hours at RT.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Remove the blocking solution and incubate the cells with the appropriate primary antibodies at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Wash and add secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with DPBS, then incubate the cells with secondary antibodies for 1 hour at RT.

steps.title: Wash and stain nuclei with DAPI
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with DPBS; during the second DPBS wash add DAPI to DPBS at 1 µL/mL and incubate for 2 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Image cells by confocal microscopy
steps.instruction: Image the plate using a DragonFly Confocal Dual Spinning Disk microscope with a 60× magnification, 1.4 numerical aperture objective.

steps.title: Quantify mitochondrial morphology in Imaris
steps.instruction: Using the Surface module of Imaris 10.2, quantify mitochondrial volume, area, sphericity, and OXPHOS complex fluorescence intensity.

steps.title: Assess mitochondrial networking
steps.instruction: Determine mitochondrial networking features according to previously published methods.
